core_idea: The Thumb East Capo IIII Meursault is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Tigermark Rounds** damage carry who applies **Tremor — Scorch** and **Burn** on hits, spending ammo for burst on S3. Scaling conditions: Final Power +1 per 4 (Burn + Tremor) (max +3); Final Power +1 per 4 (Burn + Tremor) (max +4). Equipping defense once reloads **Savage Tigermark Round** and unlocks the upgraded S3.
playstyle_guide:
- **Burst** when you're ready to break the stagger target.
- Equipping a defense skill for the first time this encounter reloads Savage Tigermark Round and unlocks the upgraded skill set — plan when you switch to defense to trigger the reload.
- Manage **Tigermark Rounds** — multiple skills spend limited ammo on coin flips. Preserve **Tigermark Rounds** for S3; when reserves are low, skip or pass on weaker S1, S2 so your strongest skill keeps fully empowered coins.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Final Power +1 per 4 (Burn + Tremor) (max +3).

**S1 — Double Slash - Blast ['''爆''']** (BP 4, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 4, high 12 (High).
- Final Power +1 for every 4 (Burn + Tremor) on the main target (max 3)
- Final Power +1 per 4 (Burn + Tremor) (max +3)

**S2 — Triple Slash - Blast ['''爆''']** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- Final Power +1 for every 4 (Burn + Tremor) on the main target (max 4)
- Final Power +1 per 4 (Burn + Tremor) (max +4)

**S3 — Tanglecleaver ['''快刀亂麻''']** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average).
- If this unit has Savage Tigermark Round, activate 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades' instead ; - [Before Use] If this unit does not have Savage Tigermark Round, cancel activation ; Coin Power +1 for every 8 (Burn + Tremor) on the main target, (max 2)
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Burn + Tremor)** (+1 per 8, max +2) — build stacks first.
- triggers Amplitude Conversion, converting the target's Tremor to this kit's subtype
- Spend 1 Tigermark Round; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Tremor Count; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Burn Count

*↳ Alternate S3 — Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades ['''超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬''']* (BP 3, CP +3): rolls — low 3, high 18 (Slightly High).

  - At 1+ Tigermark Round, convert all Coins of 'Tanglecleaver' into Unbreakable Coins.
  - Skill Coins that spend Tigermark Round gain +1 Power and deal +10% damage (activates only as long as the Coin has Rounds left to spend).
